physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Einstein Cross is recorded here: its package frames it at 287,620 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), Einstein Cross: position from 1994AJ....107..461B, redshift from 2017A&A...600A..79A (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=Einstein%20Cross); NED preferred values of Einstein Cross: RA 340.1261289°, Dec 3.358619494° (1994AJ....107..461B); redshift 1.695 (2017A&A...600A..79A)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 1.695 (NED, 2017A&A...600A..79A) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 4825987655.111077 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the redshift z = 1.695: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space. NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), Einstein Cross: position from 1994AJ....107..461B, redshift from 2017A&A...600A..79A (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=Einstein%20Cross).
